notes: all thy life long renders mēʿôdəkā: the min takes all, ʿôd takes life long and the suffix thy. The competing reading gives all thy life long whole to ʿôd and leaves the min unrepresented; it is named in that unit's note.
Both interrogative particles take the fronted words the ASV writes for them, Am under rule 20's verbless clause and was under rule 17.
